Awful food
Jun 2026 • Couples
Absolutely terrible restaurant. We ordered, calamari, chips (fries). The dish both were cold and soggy. We refused and left the restaurant, by the way paid 2 beer we drank. As we were walking out the restaurant, I saw that the food, fries already cooked maybe a couple of hours before. What they do, just warm up the dish a bit and serve. We went to next door restaurant, and found out the same owner of these two restaurants. I was surprised that the dish at this restaurant was tasty and freshly cooked.

Good food, good location, spotty service
Mar 2026 • Couples
When we ate here for dinner, food good, service good. Delightful Very entertaining watching the activity on the street below. When we ate here for lunch, food was good, but the service was terrible. When we arrived for lunch (two of us) there was only one other person in the restaurant. After quite a while no food arrived. We had to remind the waitress three times what we ordered. She didn’t seem to remember that we ordered food. The restaurant was not busy. It took 40 minutes to get fried fish. Other people gave up and left.
